related.title: LLNL 平行計算：強擴展與核心效率
related.titleEn: LLNL parallel computing: strong scaling and core efficiency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付階段預算、同工作證明與效能解讀限制；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver phase budgets, equal-work evidence, and interpretation limits. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫固定格點數與P變化，列每案TP、S、E及P×TP，避免效率與吞吐混用；兩效率可重算且問題固定，報告保留速度、效率與資源時間不同單位。
related.differenceEn: Draw fixed grid size with varying P. Tabulate TP, S, E, and P×TP separately. Reproduce both efficiencies with fixed work. Distinguish speedup, efficiency, and resource-time units.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定各階段工作時，總時間是階段和；只加速SpMV不能消除平滑、歸約與其他成本；合成SpMV40、平滑30、歸約20、其他10毫秒；SpMV由40改20；名義式 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration；變更式 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
S(P)=T1/TP，E=S/P；必須同一問題、正確性與計時邊界；合成T1=120秒，P4時TP36秒，P8時TP22秒；名義式 120/36/4 = 0.833333333333 parallel efficiency；變更式 120/22/8 = 0.681818181818 parallel efficiency。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With fixed work, total time sums phase times. Faster SpMV does not eliminate smoothing, reductions, or other costs. Synthetic SpMV = 40, smoothing = 30, reduction = 20, other = 10 milliseconds; change SpMV to 20. Nominal 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration; changed 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

S(P) = T1/TP and E = S/P require the same problem, correctness criterion, and timing boundaries. Synthetic T1 = 120 seconds, TP = 36 at P = 4, and TP = 22 at P = 8. Nominal 120/36/4 = 0.833333333333 parallel efficiency; changed 120/22/8 = 0.681818181818 parallel efficiency. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 科學計算驗收：製造解與網格收斂
related.titleEn: Scientific computing acceptance: manufactured solutions and convergence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付階段預算、同工作證明與效能解讀限制；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver phase budgets, equal-work evidence, and interpretation limits. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列解析度、格距、誤差範數、邊界與迭代容差；製造解作獨立參考，不能拿最細網格當絕對真值；兩段p=2可重算，誤差定義、漸近假設與未涵蓋物理限制都記錄。
related.differenceEn: Record resolution, spacing, error norm, boundaries, and solver tolerance. Use a manufactured solution rather than assuming the finest grid is exact. Reproduce both observed orders of 2. Record the error norm, asymptotic assumption, and unmodeled physical limitations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定各階段工作時，總時間是階段和；只加速SpMV不能消除平滑、歸約與其他成本；合成SpMV40、平滑30、歸約20、其他10毫秒；SpMV由40改20；名義式 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration；變更式 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

若E(h)=Ch^p，網格間距縮半時p=log2(Eh/Eh/2)；需在漸近區且解/邊界一致；合成誤差E_h=.04、E_h/2=.01；另一組下一層誤差.0025，計相鄰兩段階數；名義式 log2(.04/.01) = 2 observed order；變更式 log2(.01/.0025) = 2 observed order。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With fixed work, total time sums phase times. Faster SpMV does not eliminate smoothing, reductions, or other costs. Synthetic SpMV = 40, smoothing = 30, reduction = 20, other = 10 milliseconds; change SpMV to 20. Nominal 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration; changed 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

If E(h) = C h^p, halving spacing gives p = log 2(E(h)/E(h/2)). This requires consistent boundaries and an asymptotic regime. Synthetic errors 0.04, 0.01, and 0.0025 at successively halved spacings. Calculate both adjacent observed orders. Nominal log2(.04/.01) = 2 observed order; changed log2(.01/.0025) = 2 observed order. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
